title: Headless TTW Plik's Safari (DLC04FF06): from Plik's registration and fee through the arena's ghoul hunt to his congratulations (stage 100, quest completed)

actions.text: Given: the player out of Vault 101 (MQ01 10), across to Point Lookout with The Local Flavor done (DLC04MQ01 200: its chain), standing on Point Lookout's landing (where the voyage puts the player [observed]), with 1000 caps for the safari's fee (Plik's 'That's the spirit' line needs them [observed]). Plik's Safari (DLC04FF06) runs from the start [observed].

Path: Plik at his safari (his greeting, DLC04FF06HostReg01, the fee paid: DLC04FF06hostPayEnter, stage 50, the arena door unlocked), the arena's button (DLC04FF06startButtonSCRIPT: 51, the ghoul cages open), the ghouls of all the waves killed (each death adds to BodyCount; at 26 the script sets 70) [observed], and Plik's congratulations (100: the quest done, the Dismemberer).

actions.label: plik: welcome to my extraordinary safari

actions.text: Into the arena; its button (DLC04FF06startButtonSCRIPT [observed]) sets 51, locks the door, opens the ghoul cages and places the first ghouls.
The first ghoul out is killed (its OnDeath, DLC04FF06ghoulSCRIPT, adds one to BodyCount) [observed].

Stand-in for the rest of the fight: the ghouls are placed by the button's script (PlaceAtMe at the cave spawns, wave by wave as BodyCount reaches 5, 9, 14 and 19) and have no names; the runner's created: name gives the newest one even once dead, so they cannot be killed one by one here. BodyCount is set as their deaths would leave it, wave by wave, and at 26 the script ends the hunt (70) [observed].
